profile.description: 2026 county fair prospect. Official 2026 fair runs Sept. 2-7 in Filer. Fair office: 208-326-4396. General Manager Jerre Christophersen remains the verified current manager on the official site.

notes.subject: Latest contact — Melody callback and Aug. 26 email
notes.body: Adventure Zone sent outreach Aug. 25, 2026. A fair contact identifying herself as Melody called Desiree back. Desiree attempted to return the call but did not reach her, then sent a detailed follow-up Aug. 26 to fair@tfcfair.com explaining the current-year/future-year opportunity and both prepaid and pay-for-play models. Do not treat the old Aug. 25 email action as still due. Melody's full identity/role has not been verified, so do not merge her with Melanie Lunney or replace Jerre Christophersen as primary contact without confirmation.

notes.subject: Current 2026 research
notes.body: Official Twin Falls County Fair sources confirm the 2026 fair runs Sept. 2-7 at 215 Fair Avenue, Filer ID. Official About page lists Jerre Christophersen as General Manager and the fair office at 208-326-4396. Fair-season office hours are 12 PM-8 PM through Sept. 7. Because the fair begins within days, the next useful action is a phone check-back rather than another email tonight.

notes.subject: Online application required
notes.body: Desiree confirmed that The Adventure Zone needs to fill out an online application for the Twin Falls County Fair. Keep this requirement with the surviving fair profile; no application link, deadline, or submission confirmation is recorded yet.

followUps.label: PRIORITY — Call Twin Falls after Melody callback
followUps.reason: Melody called back and Desiree sent the detailed Aug. 26 follow-up after missing her return call. Call the fair office on Aug. 28 if there is still no response; ask for Melody or the person handling entertainment/attractions. Fair starts Sept. 2, so do not let the stale Aug. 25 email follow-up remain as the next action.
